headline: IT engineer who studies law, explaining cybersecurity in Hinglish.

lawCallout.title: Why law + tech
lawCallout.body: Most security content explains how attacks work. Studying law means I also look at what the law says about them, and what organisations must do to comply.
points: IT Act, 2000: offences like unauthorised access (s.43, s.66), identity theft (s.66C) and cheating by impersonation (s.66D)
Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023: consent, data-fiduciary duties and breach obligations
CERT-In directions: incident reporting for organisations
GRC: turning these rules into policies, risk registers and audits
